semantic_conclusions.subject: Entry, real lane, pre-try effects and request assignment
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Console Stage runs within the original participating delegate; browser claim and health validation precede Explorer consumption and local try. Request defaults allocate ID/time before the awaited reminder; assignment to request occurs only after that initializer succeeds. The retained request/frame and pre-prefix enrollment are explicitly proposals, not existing custody.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Health and validation remain effectful independent owners
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Stage uses ordinaryEntry=false and no repair-loop/rollback/progression arguments. It runs mirror repair, live aggregation, mod/settings health, notifications, guarded return/attraction helpers, QTE health and schedule initialization before validation. All includes accepted-materialization validators; it does not select alternate bits26/27. Spiritual-mismatch early false is distinct from the ordinary error/report-delete/input branch. Successful repair-artifact deletes and failed-validation report delete are independent effects, not an atomic cohort.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Reminder, mods and QTE consumption
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: All27 direct reminder call lines match. Mods use the actual resolved mods root, native enumeration/metadata and leased content reads even when content is omitted from returned descriptors. Manifest semantic equality excludes only _lastUpdated; Settings assignment/config save remain distinct. QTE summary is cleared and saved before returned; hooks can fail after committed publication. Source-consuming replay is not an accepted continuation.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Dice/gacha branch, allocation and entropy fidelity
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Stage uses public no-lease GetOrCreate. Reuse checks only nonnull state, visible length20, nonnull gacha and nonblank rarity; explicit JSON null visible array throws outside deserialize catch. Valid reuse has no application RNG/write but model clock defaults and lower read recovery remain. Fresh successful branch has20+4 separate Fill calls, modulo20+1, hidden-score thresholds and empty DiceUsed. No reward or turn increment. Partial arrays are not currently externally retained; slot custody and remaining-work policy are open.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Actual FS/publication boundary and its limits
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: The real public read can recover and reacquire/reread; public write serializes exact timestamped state with BOM and acquires its own canonical lease. UsesTrustedLocalWriter preserves recorder/recovery/artifact branches. Directory creation precedes mutation registration; callbacks and retry attempts are additional work. Committed with cleanup failure is a retained decision, not cleanup/quiescence. The named publisher boundary is not a closed native leaf or original retained-custody implementation.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Progression, preview, skill and characteristics call specificity
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Schedule initialization and next-turn construction are separate mutating passes; next control writes an updated schedule before returning. Afterlife preview has early ineligibility/null paths and read-quiescence admission. Skill catalog uses three actual roots and may degrade read issues to empty authority. Stage calls ComputeAsync, not the file-writing ComputeAndWriteAsync. Typed held must not be swallowed by existing optional-computation/read-issue catches. The unexpanded helper bodies remain explicitly open.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Backup, snapshot roles, exact request writes and Explorer custody
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Explorer rollback reference is consumed before local try and must remain in original custody. Raw inventory validation, rollback copies, validation overrides, original proof and later restoration are distinct. Seven fixed transient deletions include progression_report under control; no namespace sweep is authorized. Console publishes provisional request then exact-before conditional replacement, while browser uses its actual staged path. Original snapshot evidence is not a generic write grant or recreated owner.

semantic_conclusions.subject: Error, held, cleanup and parent completion separation
semantic_conclusions.conclusion: Actual source error handling is preserved: SessionReplaced rethrows, Uncertain bypasses broad staging cleanup, browser staging retains evidence, console error can delete/restore/cleanup. Typed held is a proposed distinct branch and cannot become cancellation, missing JSON, optional failure, orphan classification, rollback or new storage in finalization. Child Stage success does not prove parent/native/pin retirement. Safe unresolved HOLD is not lawful ordinary completion.
